g1.scale: linear; F_G in percent, F_theta in degrees
g1.limits: automatic, same axis for both families
g1.greyscale: original = black filled circles; S2alt = open squares, grey; whiskers = each family's own conservative U

g2.scale: logarithmic magnitudes (F_G as a fraction, F_theta in degrees)
g2.greyscale: marker shapes distinguish |Q|, cross-family drift, primary U and conservative U

g3.greyscale: solid black (original) vs dashed grey with open squares (S2alt)

g4.data: R1 S2alt case records none, c0p5_100, c0p5_010, c2p0_101 (u, labels, materials); g2_t6_point_stress at element centroids; plane-stress von Mises
g4.scale: panel a: lg(sigma_eq) in [-5, -2] (1st-99.5th percentile, rounded to 0.5); panels b-d: relative change clipped to +/-0.5
g4.limits: GLOBAL common limits in r1_g4_stress_global_grey; LOCAL per-panel limits (99th percentile of |change|) in r1_g4b_stress_local_grey
g4.greyscale: monotonic grey; signed maps on grey range 0.20-0.97; black contours (solid +, dashed -, bold zero) from a 0.5 mm grid interpolation of centroid values (holes masked)

g5.data: accepted M4.B original-family records none, c0p5_100, c0p5_010, c0p5_111 (element strain energy / element area)
g5.greyscale: as g4 signed maps; greyscale replacement of M4.B fig. Ж.5

g6.greyscale: filled circles = soft, open triangles = stiff; greyscale replacement of M4.B fig. Ж.2

g7.greyscale: dark grey = resolved by both rules, light grey = primary only; greyscale replacement of M4.B fig. Ж.3

colormap: monotonic greyscale (MATLAB gray), unsigned: dark = high; signed: dark = negative, light = positive, range 0.20-0.97
font: Arial (all text Ukrainian; decimal comma; true minus sign)
